desc: Derive the direction-aware potential formulation and pairwise incompatibility characterization.
Classify forbidden traveler pairs by interval geometry, endpoint sharing, and travel directions.
Establish that infeasibility is pairwise for this constraint system.
Design preprocessing of each person’s earliest incompatible index and range-maximum query answering.
Correct the off-by-one bounds in the 2D crossing queries and validate the complete Python solution on both samples and edge cases.
